value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks nice during the day: mostly sunny to partly cloudy and dry, with a high around 69–73°F. It cools down overnight to about 45–48°F, and showers are likely after midnight, with about a 60% chance. Wednesday may stay showery and feel cooler, so bring a jacket.
